segments.text: The puzzle shows xi equals iv plus 2, which reads as 11 equals 4 plus 2, 11 equals 6.
By moving one vertical matchstick from the xi, 11 on the left, you can change it into a vx6.
That makes the equation vi equals v plus 2, which translates to 6 equals 4 plus 2, 6, 6, 30-word explanation.
